sloka: यस्मिन्मुहूर्ते काकुत्स्थ शूद्रो ऽयं विनिपातितः ।तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते बालो ऽसौ जीवेन समयुज्यत ।। ७.७६.१५ ॥
transliteration: yasminmuhūrte kākutstha śūdro 'yaṁ vinipātitaḥ ।tasminmuhūrte bālo 'sau jīvena samayujyata ।। 7.76.15 ॥

translations.english: O Kakutstha, the very moment this Shudra was struck down, that boy was reunited with his life.
